answer: Comet-escrow identity escrow. Each new agent identity posts a deposit escrowed on a shared wharf ledger; the deposit is released only after the agent completes N verified tasks whose rewards flow through an oasis pool that pays existing agents proportional dividends. A clone farm must fund deposits for every alias, then subsidize each alias's task completions—rewards not captured because dividends route to incumbents—so each marginal clone returns less than its deposit plus task cost.
